title: Workflow concurrency groups are keyed by workflow, event name and ref
answers: How do I add concurrency to a GitHub Actions workflow in this repo?
Why do scheduled or manual runs not cancel PR runs in the same workflow?
Which concurrency group key do workflows in .github/workflows use?
How do I stop superseded PR CI runs without cancelling release runs?
body:
Convention: every `concurrency` block added to .github/workflows uses `group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.ref }}`.
Where: top-level `concurrency:` in .github/workflows/helm.yml and .github/workflows/update-model-catalog.yml.
Why it matters: `github.event_name` in the key keeps a schedule or workflow_dispatch run from sharing a group with a pull_request run on the same ref, so a PR push cannot cancel a publish run.
Cancellation: `cancel-in-progress` is `true` in helm.yml, and in update-model-catalog.yml it is `${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}` (see the workflow-concurrency note for that file).
Constraints: the PR gives no reviewer rationale for the event_name key; it is inferred from the diff. Check the triggers of a workflow before copying `cancel-in-progress: true`, because a workflow with push or schedule triggers that writes state should not be made unconditionally cancellable.
applies: Any new or edited top-level `concurrency:` block in .github/workflows/*.yml.
says: Pushing code to a pull request cancelled an active release run on that branch.
Stop superseded pull request check runs from continuing after new commits are pushed.
Scheduled pipeline runs should never share queue limits with review builds or manual triggers.
Ensure manual deployment jobs do not abort when developers push updates to review branches.
search: Top-level concurrency blocks across .github/workflows/*.yml must define group using the key ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.ref }}. Including github.event_name isolates pull_request runs from schedule or workflow_dispatch runs on the same ref, preventing PR pushes from cancelling publish runs. While helm.yml sets cancel-in-progress to true, workflows with push or schedule triggers writing state must avoid unconditional cancellation, as seen in update-model-catalog.yml.
